message: Screen Studio is a macOS screen recorder that a solo founder uses to record a product walkthrough and get a polished demo video out of it without doing manual video editing. Verified product facts support this first-email scope: Record a product walkthrough with Screen Studio on a Mac, where the cursor is recorded as synchronized movement data and added back afterwards so cursor effects can be applied after recording (E3), then export the result up to 4K at 60 fps (E6) under the Monthly plan at $29/mo, which includes all Screen Studio features (E5). Draft this documented use. Treat recipient circumstances as unconfirmed.
